newsitem.title: POLAND: NFI UNITS LEAP ON TAX NEWS, Q1 PROFITS.
newsitem.headline: NFI UNITS LEAP ON TAX NEWS, Q1 PROFITS.

text.p: Polish NFI units jumped 5.9 percent to 151.5 zlotys after finance minister suggested to scrap to levy tax on profits on sales of NFIs' firms and after most of NFIs had profits in the first quarter of 1997.
"There is a combination of two factors - there is a chance that the tax idea will be scrapped and the first quarter results seem to be good," one trader said.

Late last month the finance ministry said that from the start of 1998 the 15 NFIs would have to pay a 36 percent tax on gains they made from sales of companies in their portfolios, which caused an about 10-percent fall of NFI units.
But the finance minister on Friday suggested that he might ask the parliament to scrap the tax for NFIs.
Late on Friday 11 NFIs reported net profits after most of them had losses in the whole 1996.
